part.text:
Fixed in `app/product/page.tsx`. The product page was blocking on `getInventory()` before rendering any HTML, so the title was delayed.

Now it uses a `Suspense` boundary: the static title renders immediately, and the inventory count/price stream in when the async fetch completes. The build confirms `/product` now uses Partial Prerender (PPR).
